CustomField.description: API name of the field on the target object whose value is stamped as the display label on CustomApproval__c.RelatedToLabel__c at submission time. Typically 'Name'.
CustomField.inlineHelpText: Enter the API name of the field to use as the display label, e.g. Name. This value is resolved on the target record and stored on the approval.
CustomField.label: Target Label Field API Name
